description: This file defines custom matchers and utilities for Playwright's expect API, including proxy-based matcher creation, polling support, and integration with test steps.

classes.name: ExpectMetaInfoProxyHandler
classes.description: Proxy handler for managing matcher calls with context, supporting nested matchers and polling.

methods.name: createMatchers
methods.description: Creates a proxy for matchers with context and prefix.

methods.name: qualifiedMatcherName
methods.description: Generates a qualified matcher name based on qualifier array and matcher name.

methods.name: createExpect
methods.description: Creates a proxy-based expect object with support for extension, soft mode, polling, and configuration.

methods.name: setMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Sets the current matcher call context.

methods.name: takeMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current matcher call context.

methods.name: wrapPlaywrightMatcherToPassNiceThis
methods.description: Wraps a matcher to pass Playwright-specific context.

methods.name: throwUnsupportedExpectMatcherError
methods.description: Throws error for unsupported custom matchers.

methods.name: pollMatcher
methods.description: Performs polling for a matcher until timeout or success.

methods.name: mergeExpects
methods.description: Merges multiple expect objects into one.
